name: Ziba AI Content Creator
author: siteziba

sections.description:
Ziba AI Content Creator is a complete AI-powered content generation plugin for WordPress. It automatically produces long-form, SEO-optimized Persian content and schedules it for publication.

Key Features

  • AI Content Generation — Generate articles (posts), static pages, and WooCommerce product descriptions directly from your dashboard.
  • Dual AI Engine Support — Use the free Pollinations engine (no API key required) or connect any OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, and others) with your own key.
  • Automatic Featured Images — Creates a featured image for every generated post using either AI (Pollinations) or the local GD library, with optional logo overlay and watermark.
  • SEO Built-in — Automatically generates SEO title, meta description, focus keyword, tags, and internal/external links. Compatible with Yoast SEO and Rank Math.
  • Smart Internal Linking — Analyzes existing posts and naturally links to them, improving site structure and SEO.
  • Competitor Research — Before writing, the AI analyzes top-ranking articles to identify content gaps and structure.
  • Chunked Generation — Writes in multiple passes to reach your target word count (default 1200+) without hitting token limits.
  • Automatic Scheduling — Set hourly, daily, weekly, or custom intervals and let the plugin publish content automatically via WP-Cron.
  • One-Time Custom Mode — Override topic, post type, status, or extra prompt for a single manual run without touching global settings.
  • WooCommerce Support — Generate full product descriptions with proper SEO metadata.
  • Multilingual Ready — Optimized for Persian (RTL), with built-in Persian text shaping for images.

How It Works

  1. Choose topics manually or let AI pick based on your categories.
  2. The plugin crafts a detailed prompt, sends it to your selected AI provider, and parses the response.
  3. If the article is shorter than your minimum word count, it expands automatically with additional sections.
  4. Content is cleaned, internal/external links are enriched, and the post is created with full metadata.
  5. A featured image is generated and attached, complete with your site logo and watermark.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ziba-ai-content-creator folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP file through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Ziba AI → Settings and configure:
    • AI Engine: Choose Pollinations (free) or enter your custom OpenAI-compatible API endpoint and key.
    • Content Settings: Set minimum word count, post type, category, and optional extra prompt.
    • Featured Image Settings: Enable/disable AI or local image generation and optionally select a custom logo.
    • Automation Schedule: Choose how often to auto-generate content.
  4. Go to Ziba AI and click Generate Content Now to test a manual run.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No. The built-in Pollinations engine is completely free and requires no registration. If you want higher reliability or different models, you can configure any OpenAI-compatible API in Settings.

Which AI providers are supported?

Pollinations (default, free) and any OpenAI-compatible API endpoint. This includes OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Anthropic (via proxy), Google Gemini (via proxy), Mistral, Together AI, and self-hosted models like Ollama or LM Studio.

How long does it take to generate one article?

On the free Pollinations engine with default settings (1200 words + featured image), expect 3 to 6 minutes per article. This includes rate-limit pauses required by the free tier (30 seconds between requests). Using a paid API like OpenAI reduces this to under a minute.

Does it work with Yoast SEO and Rank Math?

Yes. The plugin automatically fills the SEO title, meta description, and focus keyword fields used by both Yoast and Rank Math.

Can I generate content in languages other than Persian?

The plugin is optimized for Persian (RTL) but works with any language. Adjust the extra prompt in Settings to specify a different language.

Does the plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Choose “Product Description” as the content type when running the generator, and it will create SEO-friendly descriptions for your products.

What about featured images?

The plugin supports three modes:
* Auto (default) — Tries AI first, falls back to GD.
* AI Only — Pollinations only.
* Local Only — GD library only (no external calls, fastest).

Both AI and local images include your site logo and a custom watermark.

Is this plugin compatible with WordPress Multisite?

Yes, it works on Multisite networks, though each site maintains its own settings and content.
sections.changelog:
2.3.1

  • Fixed: Watermark text is now properly centered inside the black background box with uppercase styling.
  • Fixed: SEO-friendly image filenames generated from post slugs.
  • Fixed: Step locks prevent parallel content/expand requests from host retries.
  • Fixed: Atomic lock via direct MySQL INSERT IGNORE bypasses object cache issues.
  • Fixed: Cancel button now stops all jobs from the same user via per-user transient.
  • Fixed: UTF-8 encoding for Persian log messages.
  • Fixed: Featured image async polling reduces UI flakiness.
  • Improved: Rate-limit handling with 31-second gap for text and 46-second gap for images.
  • Improved: Response caching (transient) prevents duplicate API calls for the same job step.
  • Improved: Extra Prompt is now injected as a high-priority directive in every AI request.
  • Improved: Slugs auto-generated with 5-7 descriptive English words.

2.3.0

  • New: AI image generation for featured images.
  • New: WooCommerce product description support.
  • New: One-Time Custom run mode for guide pages.
  • New: Competitor research step for SEO depth.
  • Improved: Chunked generation to reach 1200+ words reliably.
  • Improved: Yoast and Rank Math SEO integration.
